12 Lamed: a tall lamp post with a bent arm lighting a row of short letters on a desk; 13 Mem: a small camping tent with its door flap open and a glass of water beside it; 14 Nun: a nun in a habit kneeling and bowing, side view, next to a lit candle; 15 Samekh: a round squishy cushion with a person sitting on it, air hissing out; 16 Ayin: a large cartoon eye winking, with a hand over its mouth; 17 Pe / Fe: a mouth blowing a bubble with a party horn, side view; 17 Fe (pe without the dot): a mouth with its tongue out softly blowing a feather away; 18 Tsadi: a small fly with wings up sitting on a slice of pizza; 19 Kof: a kooky monkey hanging by its tail from a branch; 20 Resh: a smooth round head in profile growling, with a ball rolling down a ramp behind; 21 Shin / Sin: a birthday cake with three candle flames and a finger to the lips; 21 Sin (shin with the dot on the left): a cartoon person mid-sneeze beside a candle whose three flames lean away; 25 Nun sofit: a nun standing straight in a garden beside a tall pole; 26 Fe sofit: a cartoon mouth with a long tongue blowing a feather off a spoon; 27 Tsadi sofit: a leafy tree with Y-shaped branches and a long straight trunk. groups.title: Torah service steps
groups.prompt: Make 10 images in STYLE GUIDE v1 (1792x1024), a step of the Torah service, one scene per step: 1 the ark curtain being drawn open by a congregant, the gold-lit ark interior with scrolls in their mantles; 2 the Torah procession (hakafah) circling the sanctuary, people reaching out with the corners of closed prayer books, seen from above; 3 hagbah: a strong lifter raising the open Torah scroll high so the whole congregation sees the columns, which are shown only as soft pale bands with no marks; 4 gelilah: two people rolling the scroll closed and tying its binder, the mantle waiting on the table; 5 Noa standing at the bimah for an aliyah, one hand touching the scroll edge, tallit on her shoulders; 6 a reader guiding a silver yad pointer along the open scroll, the parchment shown only as blank pale bands; 7 Ari and Noa in the pews, a small child between them on tiptoe to see the scroll; 8 the Torah being carried back to the ark while the congregation faces it and sings; 9 the ark closing, the curtain falling, a red-gold eternal-light lamp glowing above; 10 dressing the Torah: velvet mantle, silver breastplate and crown laid out on a table, one hand fixing the pointer chain.
